name: Kanrinin - Itsuwari no Maid wa Uragiri ni Somaru
original_name: 姦裏人 偽りのメイドは裏切りに染まる
source:
There is a man called the "Manager." Making a living by doing businesses in the underworld, he is also known by his true identity "Dark Shipper." At the request of his clients, he provides a "thorough management" to their targets, after making them into an "obedient product", they are shipped to his clients.

Even though he had just finished a request recently, there is no time for him to rest. This time, a request arrives from the first son of a certain famous and wealthy family, to infiltrate a wedding reception which also serves as an inheritance announcement event.

The objective is to beat a spy sent by the second son of the family who is not pleased with the inheritance and plans to disqualify the first son from the inheritance rights. Basically, to the make the second son lose his rights.

If it was just a request to beat the spy, he would have turn it down, but after seeing the spy's profile, he decides to accept it.

"Kururugi Shouko"

Accepting an unusual request,  the "Manager" prepares himself, setting his sights on his new target.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://binbin1919.com/SKDG/kanrinin2/index.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
有一个人叫“经理”。以在黑社会做生意为生，他的真实身份也被称为“黑暗托运人”。按照客户的要求，他对目标对象进行“彻底的管理”，做成“听话的产品”后，发货给客户。

虽然最近刚刚完成了一个委托，但他却没有时间休息。这次，接到某名门大公子的请求，要潜入一场婚宴，同时也是一场继承宣布仪式。

目的是击败二儿子派来的间谍，该间谍对继承权不满意，并计划取消大儿子的继承权。基本上，是为了让二儿子失去他的权利。

如果只是要求殴打间谍，他会拒绝，但看到间谍的资料后，他决定接受。

《栗木翔子》接受了一个不寻常的请求，“经理”做好了准备，将目光投向了他的新目标。

[翻译编辑自[url=https://binbin1919.com/SKDG/kanrinin2/index.html#story]官网[/url]]
